name: off
text:
ti ta ta tik tik shake!
pa dun du da────, ah
trans:
"ti ta ta tik tik shake! pa dun du da────, ah"
(She was bright and sparkly.)

name: ルカ
text: えっ──
trans: Whhuh——?

name: ルカ
text:
ママ！　ママ！
これママだよね！？
trans:
Mama! It's Mama!
Hey, that's Mama, right?!

name: ルカ
text: なんで！？　なんでー！？
trans:
Why's Mama there?!
Why were you there?!

name: off
text:
ti ta ta tik tik shake!
pa dun du da────, ah
trans:
"ti ta ta tik tik shake! pa dun du da────, ah"
(She seemed like a princess straight out of
a fairytale.)

name: ルカの母
text:
…………
ママは昔、アイドルだったの
trans:
......
You see, Mama used to be an idol before.

name: ルカ
text: アイドル────！？
trans: An idol————?!?!

name: ルカ
text:
すごいすごい！
ママ、すごーい！
trans:
Wowie!! Wow!!
Mama, you're so amazing!!

name: off
text: ひんやりして　ね　ぴったりじゃない
trans:
"It's cold, right? / Isn't it perfect"
(I was instantly mesmerized by her.)

name: テレビの音声
text:
『新旧アイドル特集
ベテラン世代が青春を捧げた懐かしのアイドルの姿は──』
trans:
"Spotlight on veteran and rising idols! The nostalgic
star who devoted her youth in the veteran idol era
has been spotted..."

name: ルカの母
text: ……すごくないよ
trans: ......I'm not amazing at all.

name: ルカ
text:
？
ママ？　なんかいった？
trans:
Hm?
Mama, what did you say?

name: ルカの母
text:
────……
……ううん、なんでもない
trans:
......Forget it,
it's nothing.

name: off
text: 今夜　わたしを　つれていく靴
trans:
"Tonight, these shoes / That carry me along"
(I was happy because it was a perfect fit on her.)

name: ルカ
text: かえったらママみたい！
trans: I wanna watch Mama when we get home!

name: ルカの母
text: ……他のじゃダメ？
trans: ......We can't watch something else?

name: ルカ
text:
ママのおうたがいいの！
れんしゅうするんだもん！
trans:
No! I wanna hear Mama's song!
I'm gonna practice it!

name: ルカ
text: ママみたいなアイドルになるんだよ！
trans: I'm gonna be an idol just like Mama!

name: off
text: そうだよ　赤いじゅうたん駆けて
trans:
"That's right / I'll run on the red carpet"
(I really believed that I can become one like her.)

name: ルカの母
text: ……ママが、アイドルだったって
trans: The fact that your Mama used to be an idol.....

name: ルカ
text:
？
うん
trans:
Hm?
Yeah?

name: ルカの母
text:
誰かに言っちゃダメだよ
……お約束、できる？
trans:
You can't share it to anybody, okay?
......Can you promise Mama?

name: off
text: そうだよ　月までだって行けるわ
trans:
"That's right / I can go to the moon"
(I wanted to become a dazzling princess, just like
Mama.)

name: プレーヤーから漏れる音
text:
『ti ta ta tik tik shake!
pa dun du da────, ah』
trans:
"ti ta ta tik tik shake! 
pa dun du da────, ah"

name: ルカ
text: ふー……！
trans: Phew.....!

name: ルカ
text: ママー！
trans: Mamaaa!

name: ルカ
text: お手伝いある！？
trans: Can I help with anything?!

name: 店の常連客
text:
おっ、今日も偉いねぇ
ママ大好きだな
trans:
Aww, she wants to help out again today.
Ya sure love your Mama a lot.

name: ルカ
text: うん！
trans: Yup!

name: ルカの母
text:
もう──
大人しくしてなさいって言ってるのに
trans:
Jeez—
I keep telling you, just sit still.

name: 店の常連客
text:
なんだよぅ、ちゃんとお利口さんにしてるよなぁ
あ、娘ちゃん、今日も歌ってくれねぇか？
trans:
C'mon, don't scold her for being a good girl. 
Hey, young miss. Are ya gonna sing today too?

name: ルカ
text:
いいよー？
おじちゃん、デュエットにする？
trans:
Sure—!
Gramps, wanna make it a duet?

name: ルカの母
text: こら──
trans: Stop thaaat.

name: 店の常連客
text: ははっ、こりゃ気合い入れねぇと！
trans: Haha! Well, I'd have to step up my game for ya, then!

name: off
text:
ti ta ta tik tik shake!
pa dun du da────, ah
trans:
ti ta ta tik tik shake! pa dun du da────, ah
(That was all I had in the beginning. Nothing more
than an adorable wish.)
